purpose: Upgrade V71 from a single raw ETL fixture to one coupled hidden biological truth observed through FULL104-like, Stage4-like, SCENIC+-like, Morabito-like, perturbation-like, spatial-like and checkpoint-twin interfaces.

shared_hidden_truth.rule: All dataset emulators are projections of the same generated truth. Independent per-dataset truth generation is forbidden.

post_S99_requirements: Stage4 controls are promoter-fixed rather than globally random
control distance is matched within max(10 percent of linked distance, 10 kb)
linked and control intervals are distinct and non-overlapping
an edge with no admissible control is explicitly trimmed rather than silently replaced

post_S102_requirements.forbidden: No numeric G2 threshold or equivalence margin may be inferred from V2 or K-curve outcomes.
post_S102_requirements.synthetic_output_rule: Fixtures may emit raw control-vs-control deltas and the scale-free |CVC delta|/|primary delta| diagnostic, but must not label a new G2 rule PASS until prospectively specified.

overlap_geometry: one external peak may overlap multiple Stage4 windows
crosswalk must enumerate all overlaps, never first hit only
barcode_identity: barcode suffix is not donor identity
synthetic paired-multiome cohort deliberately contains suffixes shared by multiple donors
all producers use explicit barcode→donor authority

raw_route_requirements.route_B: fragments.tsv.gz → donor-aware pseudobulk → peak calling/consensus adapter
raw_route_requirements.note: SMALL_CI may use a deterministic peak-calling adapter in place of MACS binary execution, but it must consume fragment records and emit the same route boundary objects.

acceptance: all planted dataset families share donor/program/truth namespaces
truth files are physically disjoint from observable roots
semantic corruptions have tests that fail for the intended reason
no real or protected outcome is required

truth_firewall_execution.rule: A validator that can inspect both observables and hidden truth must default to observable-only and require an explicit unblind flag for truth-dependent metrics.
